goal: Optimize Belobug/VIctory-Belobug-AMD for stable, playable 30 FPS gameplay with zero visual bugs/artifacts, low RAM (<16 GB) and VRAM (<=8 GB) footprint, fast shader compilation, and broad multi-hardware compatibility.
open_discovery_policy: The task list below highlights known high-impact bottlenecks from Belobug/VIctory-Belobug-AMD, NOT a closed limit. AI agents are encouraged to analyze crates/ and apps/ and propose/implement ANY legitimate optimization, crash fix, texture/shader improvement, memory reduction, or visual artifact fix that passes SECURITY-GATE.md and eval-pr.ps1.

target_hardware.gpu: AMD Radeon RX 6600 (8 GB VRAM, RDNA2)

tasks.title: Raise 3D world frame rate from 5-8 FPS toward stable 30 FPS by cutting per-frame CPU/GPU bottlenecks
tasks.problem: Belobug/VIctory-Belobug-AMD runs at 30 fps in boot/menus but drops to 5-8 fps in the 3D world (8,800+ draws/frame).
tasks.acceptance: Measurable frame-time reduction / FPS increase in timed live runs with 0 crashes and all unit tests passing.

tasks.title: Reduce host RAM (~22 GB) and VRAM (>16 GB) footprint to fit cleanly on 16 GB RAM and 8 GB VRAM GPUs
tasks.problem: Upstream Belobug/VIctory-Belobug-AMD README reports ~22 GB host RAM and >16 GB VRAM usage, causing commit exhaustion or spilling on 16 GB RAM / 8 GB VRAM hardware.
tasks.acceptance: Lower peak RAM/VRAM usage cleanly without OOM, missing textures, or regressions.

tasks.title: Reduce copy-back and title-memory watch/stretch overhead per frame
tasks.problem: Copying modified title memory pages and GPU readbacks takes tens of milliseconds per frame.
tasks.acceptance: Lower copies ms/frame in victory output while preserving vehicle/geometry integrity.

tasks.title: Speed up shader translation/clean-up and fix driver-refused/crashing compute shader f16876929fa64f9f
tasks.problem: First-launch pipeline rebuilds take minutes of black world, water is missing until restart, and compute shader f16876929fa64f9f crashes the AMD driver compiler.
tasks.acceptance: Faster shader/pipeline compile, clean caching, and all victory-shader tests passing.

tasks.title: Fix broken in-game phone (black unlit world + empty outline) and first-run missing water
tasks.problem: Pulling up the in-game phone leaves the world unlit (black) with an empty outline, and water is missing on the first run after shader cache rebuild.
tasks.acceptance: Phone and water render properly without blackouts or flicker.

tasks.title: Optimize DirectStorage and archive streaming throughput for HDD and NVMe drives
tasks.problem: World streaming and BCPack/zlib decompression can hitch during fast traversal.
tasks.acceptance: Faster decompression/queue handling with unit tests and 0 data corruption.

tasks.title: Improve compatibility across AMD RDNA2/3/4, NVIDIA (Wave32), Intel Arc, and varied CPUs
tasks.problem: Fork was only tested on RX 9070 XT (RDNA4, 64 GB RAM); smaller VRAM GPUs (8 GB RX 6600), Wave32 GPUs, and diverse CPUs need safe tuning and fallbacks.
tasks.acceptance: Clean multi-hardware compatibility and unit tests with 0 regressions.

tasks.title: Discover and fix any other FPS, frame-pacing, texture-loading, shader-compile, RAM/VRAM, or visual-artifact issue in VIctory-AMD
tasks.problem: Any genuine bottleneck, driver timeout cause, texture/shader loading stall, visual glitch, or stability issue found by inspecting the codebase.
tasks.acceptance: Strictly scoped to VIctory-AMD, passes SECURITY-GATE.md, includes unit tests, and shows 0 crashes / 0 regressions in eval-pr.ps1.
